prompt: Build an app shell with a sidebar navigation on the left (240px wide) and a main content area on the right. The sidebar should have a logo at the top, navigation links in the middle, and a user avatar at the bottom.
assertions: Uses semantic HTML elements (nav, main, aside) with appropriate roles or aria-label
Uses .wa-split or .wa-stack with justify for distributing sidebar content (logo top, links middle, avatar bottom)
Uses className (not class) on all elements
Does NOT use @media queries for basic responsiveness (wa-flank handles it)
